description: Captured from `node extension/server.mjs` on a temp DB (LLMIDE_DB_PATH in TMPDIR, LLMIDE_ENGINE_PREWARM=0), replayed over HTTP and seeded through the API. The model text is a canned local stub (LLMIDE_ANTHROPIC_CLI, a script that prints the CLI result object), so no model call is made. includeFileContext is false, so no repo file is read; the stub returns one created file and one created test.
